text: Radish (មូឡី) is a widely popular vegetable in Cambodia, used daily in cooking. Two broad types exist: leaf-type radish and root-type radish; this source describes root-type long white radish (ដំណាំមូឡីវែង, daikon-style, sometimes labeled មូឡីស្រែ in the source). The crop originated in China and has been cultivated and consumed there for a very long time. Besides being eaten fresh, radish root is commonly processed into pickled/preserved forms such as ប្រៃក (brine-pickled radish) and ដងប៉ោ-style preserves, used as a side dish or condiment.
